suggestion.to: Our Centre for Electronic Imaging (CEI) tests how radiation damages the Teledyne e2v CIS120 CMOS sensor, which is being evaluated for TRUTHS and other next-generation missions. We measure its dark current, noise and sensitivity before and after gamma and proton irradiation, at a range of temperatures, to check it can keep the high calibration accuracy TRUTHS needs over a multi-year mission.
